Having tried both, I lean toward this second one — the search-and-pick list.

Here's why: it does the exact thing I was just worried about. I type "Res," and it narrows down to show me "Research" already exists, so I check it off instead of accidentally making a near-duplicate. That searching-my-existing-labels behavior is what keeps my labels tidy over time, which matters to me. And I can still tick off several, and still make a new one if nothing matches.

The first version felt a touch more casual and quick, which I liked, but it didn't help me find what I already had as clearly.

So my preference is this search-and-pick approach — as long as two things hold: I can still create a brand-new label right there when it isn't in the list, and my chosen labels still show up as those chips on the card. If both of those stay, this is the one I want.
